sources.title: modelapi/vit-tiny-fp16-ov-catalog · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ViT-Tiny image classification model, a Geti™ build of ViT-Tiny converted to OpenVINO™ IR with FP16 weights. It maps an input image to class scores. Model weights are hosted in the source repository OpenVINO/vit_tiny_cls-fp16-ov.
